verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is a payments and agentic-commerce platform that ships an MCP server, SDKs and APIs, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking or any way to opt out of them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
